text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I deeply apologize. I've failed once more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I believed I'd succeed in my next race if I worked hard, but I fell short again…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Is there no limit to the depths of my inexperience?!
choice_data_list: There's no need to rush things.
Your greatest enemy is the weakness within your own heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Do you mean I should first focus on strengthening myself?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, perhaps I was a little hasty. With everyone else also doing their best, victory is sure to be elusive…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've learned an important lesson. I can't let myself be swayed by results. I must keep pushing forward!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's as you say. In the time I waste moping, the other racers will only grow better and widen the gap between us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now is the time for me to grit my teeth and train!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for opening my eyes. I will strive to never lose my way again!
